records.title: A modified tissue ratio for hypobaric decompressions

observations.outcome_window: From arrival at the final test pressure to symptom report or the scheduled end of the chamber exposure.
observations.protocol: Sixty-six NASA and USAF research tests at variable altitude plateaus. Paresthesia excluded.
observations.note: Existing v1.1 conkin96 reports 211/1,075. Both records are source-specific presentations of overlapping tests. The two-event difference is unresolved.

records.note: The two reports share 66 NASA and USAF hypobaric chamber tests, 1,075 exposures, similar predictors and exclusion of paresthesia in the described DCS analysis. The 209 and 211 numerators differ for an unresolved reason. Treat the reports as overlapping.

records.title: A probabilistic model of hypobaric decompression sickness based on 66 chamber tests
records.locator: Methods, printed p. 178 (PDF p. 3); External Validation and Fig. 6, printed p. 182 (PDF p. 7)

observations.outcome_window: From arrival at the final test pressure to symptom report or the scheduled end of the chamber exposure.
observations.protocol: 52 USAF chamber groups of men. Repetitive exercise in 575 exposures, predominantly lower body in 457. Mean test pressure 5.8 psia, duration 4.66 h and tissue ratio 1.92 (0.90–2.98).
observations.note: Source-designated external validation for the 1996 model. VGE unavailable. Test-level identities and overlap with indexed historical cohorts are unresolved.

records.note: The NASA report Figure 7 and the 1998 journal Figure 4 have the same ten bins, fitted cohort size of 1,322, and 168 DCS cases. Nine printed fractions match exactly.
